mapper.select: SELECT q.question_index AS questionIndex, q.cet_word_id AS cetWordId, q.mode AS mode, q.options_json AS optionsJson, w.word AS word, w.pos AS pos, w.meaning AS meaning, CASE WHEN q.mode = 'en2cn' THEN w.meaning ELSE w.word END AS correctAnswer, a.buzz_user_id AS buzzUserId, a.answer_user_id AS answerUserId, u.username AS answerUsername, a.chosen AS chosen, a.correct AS correct, a.score_delta AS scoreDelta, a.answered_at AS answeredAt FROM pk_match_question q JOIN cet6_word w ON w.id = q.cet_word_id LEFT JOIN pk_match_answer a ON a.match_id = q.match_id AND a.question_index = q.question_index LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.answer_user_id WHERE q.match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY q.question_index ASC
